title: Gym membership freeze / exit
summary: Leaving Singapore with gym, boutique fitness, and corporate wellness memberships still billing — freeze vs cancel clocks, class packs, and how membership exit collides with movers week and school leavers fees.

sections.title: Inventory every membership and class pack
sections.body: Big-box gyms, boutique studios, swimming clubs, and corporate wellness portals often bill separately. A freeze on one brand does not stop another. Export invoices and remaining class credits the week you resign — not after the bank rail is already closing.
bullets: List every gym / studio login with next billing date and contract end
Screenshot class-pack balances and freeze eligibility windows
Ask HR whether corporate wellness deducts after your last working day

sections.title: Freeze vs cancel is not the same cash path
sections.body: Some contracts let you freeze for travel or medical leave but still charge a reduced month; others only allow cancel with notice weeks and early-termination fees. Diplomatic-clause exits and mid-month flights collide with billing cut-offs. Get the freeze and cancel quotes in writing before you pick a path.
bullets: Ask for freeze fee, max freeze months, and whether billing pauses fully
Compare cancel ETF vs remaining contract months in SGD
Do not assume “leaving Singapore” auto-qualifies as a free cancel

sections.title: Access fobs, apps, and guest passes
sections.body: Membership cards, app QR, and guest passes can outlive the billing cancel ticket. Revoke guest access and return fobs on management-office hours — not after Changi. Boutique waitlists sometimes keep your slot billed until the app profile is closed.
bullets: Return physical fobs with a dated receipt from the front desk
Delete guest / family add-ons before the primary cancel
Confirm the app login dies on the same day billing stops

sections.title: Same-week stack with movers and school fees
sections.body: Gym cancel, mover lift booking, and school leavers / yearbook fees often hit the same fortnight. Sequence so membership notice is served while you still have a Singapore number for OTP, and so leavers-fee cash is not raided by a surprise gym ETF.
bullets: Put gym notice, lift booking, and school leavers payment on one calendar
Keep one adult free for front-desk returns on cancel week

sections.title: Corporate wellness and payroll deductions
sections.body: Employer-subsidised gym desks often continue payroll deduction until HR files the stop. Leaving on a Friday does not always stop Monday’s deduction. Confirm the last deducted month and whether you owe a clawback on unused credits.
bullets: Email HR and the wellness vendor the same cancel date
Check final payslip for gym lines after EP cancel paperwork starts
Ask whether unused corporate credits transfer or expire

sections.title: Cash float: ETF vs leavers fees
sections.body: Gym early-termination fees and school leavers / yearbook invoices are small next to IR21 withhold — but they land while movers deposits are live. Keep a dedicated SGD float so a studio ETF does not raid the leavers-fee pot.
bullets: Total open gym ETFs and freeze fees before resignation week
Pay membership portals while Singapore cards and PayNow still work
